overall thoughts:

Advanced has a lot of features that are very compelling, especially:
• portfolios
• subtasks automatically added as their own cards, so you can actually visualize and move those across the board
• stakeholder reporting
If we don't move to advanced, my only hesitation with the option on your second doc is that it might be confusing to keep up with so many projects at the same time that aren't linked in a portfolio. Unless the idea is that we work on one Epic at a time (which I don't know is possible with our set up)

messages.text:
I think Matt Barber has an incorrect understanding.   He based his answer on the fact that we are not in the UK:

_"Thanks, Cydney. Given we’re predominantly US-focused for now but planning a UK launch shortly, I’d suggest a pragmatic, staged approach. We can keep things largely as-is in the short term (given current usage is limited to onboarding/service emails), but we should introduce a light-touch marketing consent mechanism so we don’t need to rework this ahead of the UK rollout._
_Suggested next steps:_
1. _Add a simple, optional marketing opt-in checkbox at sign-up (unchecked by default)_
2. _Continue treating current emails as service communications and avoid broader marketing until consent is in place_
3. _No immediate change needed for push notifications, but avoid using them for marketing for now_
4. _Ensure Privacy Policy clearly covers marketing use and opt-out_
_Ahead of the UK launch, we can then tighten slightly (ensuring marketing is only sent to opted-in users, adding preference controls if possible). I’m happy to support on updating or reviewing any of these changes (including Privacy Policy updates or consent wording)._ 

_Let me know if it's helpful to arrange a call to discuss further._

_Best rgds,_
_Matt"_

[April 12th, 2026 4:24 PM] info615: Leaving my feedback a little early this week, had a few issues this week with the new version:

-Got an email saying one of my episodes was struck for sexually explicit content, and I don't know how. Think it was miscategorized. However, it used the Description instead of the Title to tell me this, so it took me a while to figure it out. Also, it says "Under content moderation" still even though I got the email that it was banned.

-In general, having only the description and not the Title shown when you click on a post feels off. If there's a title AND a description, I think we should be able to see both. Right now, the Title only appears in the Digest.

-I have about 4 posts that have grey thumbnails on my profile page. Videos still work, but not the thumbnails.

-A few times I tried uploading this week, first day or so on the new version, and they didn't go up. I should have 110 but have 108 posts, not sure what happened there.

-Took me a minute to figure out where to create a post. Upper left-hand corner wasn't intuitive at first, but that may just be getting used to a new interface, not an actual design issue.

-Would be nice in the future to know the exact dimensions of a Daily Digest vs. Explore preview. Since the Explore doesn't list titles or descriptions, it's hard to know what each video is about without watching it. It's just a talking head and rarely is there on-screen text to explain the concept or topic, which would draw folks in. Feels like the Explore Page should also have a Title for each preview of a video.
